name: Ahrefs Analytics
description: Adds the Ahrefs Web Analytics tracking script to the site.
project_description:
This module enables seamless integration of ahrefs into your website in a quick and straightforward manner.

 Features 
 
 Ahrefs Script Integration: Automatically adds the Ahrefs script to your website. 
 Configurable Data-Key: Set the data-key value through the module’s settings. 
 Cookie Consent Compatibility: Optionally enable a Cookie Consent check by adding the data-cookieconsent="analytics" attribute to the script. This ensures compatibility with tools like Cookiebot. 
 
 Post-Installation 
 After installing the module, configure its settings via the admin interface:

Path: Settings -> System -> Ahrefs Integration

 
 Enter your ahrefs `data-key`. 
 Enable or disable the data-cookieconsent="analytics" attribute if using Cookiebot.
